description: Minimal fetch tool following the deep-research search/fetch convention. Fetches one Swiss decision's full text by id, returning {id, title, text, url, metadata}. The id comes from a `search` result (a decision_id like bger_6B_1234_2025; a docket number or BGE reference also resolves). General clients should prefer `get_decision`.

id.description: Decision id from a search result (decision_id, docket, or BGE reference).

name: fetch
title: Fetch decision (basic)
